subject: health
concept: Understanding how to assess real risk versus perceived risk in everyday situations
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Wisdom Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described activity to whether its actual risk level is higher or lower than it might feel
exercise.abstract: Student explains the difference between how risky something feels and how risky it actually is, using a described example

misconception_flags: assumes perceived risk and actual risk always match exactly

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
